rules: Never invent or replace textbook content when source-derived material is requested.
Every source-derived item must identify chapter and source page.
Generated explanations/questions must be labelled DERIVED.
Preserve activities, questions, examples, narratives, poems, maps, tables and instructions present in the source.
Do not treat teacher facilitation notes as student textbook content; preserve them separately in traceability.
Use chapter and unit boundaries exactly as defined by the textbook.
Maintain Indian terminology, names, places and context.
For multimedia resources, use search descriptors rather than fabricated URLs unless a verified official URL is available.
Do not mark a chapter complete unless source-page counts and extracted content checks pass.
